squad.selling_price_note: selling_price_m is what you actually receive if you sell a squad player (half of any rise since purchase, rounded down to £0.1m; falls in full). price_m is the current/buy price. Use selling_price_m for funds from a sale. Computed for the squad as of the squad gameweek; transfers made since are not reflected.

squad_risk_flags.name: Thomas
reasons: news: Calf injury - 50% chance of playing

free_transfers_note: Not exposed directly by any public FPL endpoint -- derived by replaying transfer history (+1 per gameweek, a wildcard week counts as one transfer, capped per max_extra_free_transfers). It is the count at the start of the gameweek after last_finished_gameweek and does not subtract transfers made since (transfer_plan applies those). free_transfers_reconciles only checks past hit costs. Treat the number as an estimate and confirm it in the app before recommending a hit.

fixture_alerts.note: Double/blank gameweeks within the current lookahead window. Usually empty well in advance of the season's congested periods -- check back as the window the data pulls covers moves closer to any known blank/double round.

transfer_candidates_note: outlook_score is a forward-looking heuristic, not a verdict: recent form + underlying attacking rate (xG+xA per 90, shrunk toward a league-average rate for small minute samples so one big cameo can't dominate) + a bonus for an easy upcoming fixture run (avg_fixture_difficulty_next_n). It exists so a good fixture swing or strong xG/xA can surface a player even when recent form alone wouldn't. Combine with live news/press conference research before acting on it.

transfer_plan.note: Expected-points optimizer. Gains are expected XI points over the horizon relative to making no transfers (hit costs included). Compare with news before acting. See caveats.
transfer_plan.hint_reason: No move this gameweek clears the thresholds (>= 1.5 expected points over banking).
caveats: Model uses season rates + status flags only: no rotation or press-conference news, penalties/set pieces, defensive contribution points or manager changes.
Fixture difficulty carries a mild weight because it was only weakly predictive in backtests.
Expected points are averages; hauls (single big games) are variance and are not predicted. Weekly point rank correlation is only ~0.3 for any model.
Confirm the free-transfer count in the app before recommending a hit.
